notes.title: Piczle World of Puzzles announced!
notes.content:
From the creator of Piczle Cross Adventure, Piczle Cross: Story of Seasons and Piczle Cross: Rune Factory comes [b]Piczle World of Puzzles[/b]!

All Piczle logic-puzzle types under one roof! Piczle Cross, Color Cross, Lines, Colors, endless puzzles! Start for free and buy DLC to add more of the puzzles you enjoy! Create and share your own! Learn how to play and become a better logic-puzzler at Piczle Academy! AND MORE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789405/6315b413462880f60d8a6f367f1631f8782a4d20.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174300/Piczle_World_of_Puzzles/]Piczle World of Puzzles[/url] will launch in Early Access some time in 2025. Wishlist now to not miss out!

notes.title: Trading cards & badges!
notes.content:
It's been one full year now since Piczle Cross: Story of Seasons was released! To celebrate this momentous event we've now added special trading cards to the game!

These aren't just your regular Steam trading cards either! Each one contains a brand new nonogram for you to clear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789405/0dd9865a0f0464592cac3b84798217b29e33af9a.png[/img]
Just take a peek at your badge progress, then zoom in on any of the trading cards you might have to see the full-sized image complete with challenging nonogram!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Can't get enough of nonograms?
notes.content:
Can't get enough of nonograms? Why not check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134280/Piczle_Cross_Rune_Factory/]Piczle Cross: Rune Factory[/url], a celebration of the Rune Factory series in nonogram form! Capture monsters, fight bosses, customize your farm, find residents and a marriage partner. Select your weapon to prepare for battles with enemies. Enjoy it at your own pace or take on a difficult challenge. Coming 2025!

notes.title: Patch notes for Mar. 15 / v.1025
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay in patching - I had to take a little time off but am now back to spring into action when required!

[list]
[*] Fixed puzzle 1 of collages 4 and 5 being unselectable with mouse
[*] Fixed puzzle preview box overlapping clues on puzzle #169
[*] Changed fixed framerate to smooth framerate (capped at 60 fps) in the hope to make the game work on frame-locked Steamdecks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Feb. 29 / v.1024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed continuous drawing bug when using system cursor
[*] Expanded the use of slightly thicker lines for larger puzzles for clarity
[*] Corrected Marian's gender in the Almanac
[*] Fixed Steam stat count for achievement #23 "Paragon of Olive Town"
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2 Feb 28 / v. 1.023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a check for collage puzzle completion in the rare case of untimely crashes (for real this time)
[*] Disabled Lumen global illumination for Steamdeck users to improve battery life
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Feb. 28 / v.1022
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added more DX11 and DX12 material format support (behind the scenes)
[*] Capped framerate to 60fps
[*] Added initial language setting based on Steam settings (1st time only)
[*] Fixed bug where pressing the hints button while hints were set to "off" would still trigger "hints used" icon
[*] Added a check for collage puzzle completion in the rare case of untimely crashes
[*] Added a feature that ever so slightly thickens grid lines on larger puzzles for visual clarity
[*] Fixed some spelling mistakes (English)
[/list]

notes.title: Piczle Cross: Story of Seasons is out NOW!
notes.content:
Finally, at long last, [b]Piczle Cross: Story of Seasons[/b] is available right now! 

Join in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2591070/discussions/]community[/url], leave a review, rate its Steamdeck compatibility, join the [url=https://discord.gg/yPXDKHy]Club Piczle Discord[/url] and, most importantly, get puzzling! The developer is listening!
